s.n: Ypres dugout leek and potato soup
s.note: Hot in a mug, the only warm thing in a flooded Flanders tunnel
s.how: Leek and potato soup cooked soft with butter and thyme, blitzed smooth and served in mugs with buttered crusty bread. Melt 40g butter and soften 2 sliced leeks and 1 chopped onion for 10 minutes. Add 600g diced potatoes, a few thyme sprigs and 1.2L vegetable stock and simmer 20 minutes until the potato breaks up. Pick out the thyme, blitz smooth, stir in 100ml cream and season well. Serve in mugs with a crusty loaf and butter.
shop: 40g butter, plus extra for the bread@Dairy

s.note: Corned beef, cheddar, lettuce and mustard pickle in soft rolls
s.how: Split and butter 4 soft white rolls. Spread each base generously with 1 tbsp sweet mustard pickle. Layer with 300g thickly sliced corned beef, a slice of vintage cheddar from 100g and a few leaves of iceberg lettuce. Add thinly sliced tomato and a crack of pepper, close and cut in half.

m.note: Corned beef hash and a fried egg, for the Red House raiders
m.how: Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes and drain well. Fry 1 diced onion in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add the potatoes and 400g diced corned beef and press flat. Cook over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning in sections, until crusty. Splash with 1 tbsp Worcestershire and add chopped parsley. Fry 4 eggs and sit one on each serve with brown sauce.

w.n: Fruit cake from home with brandy butter
w.note: Warm fruit cake with brandy butter and sharp cheddar
w.how: Beat 100g soft butter with 100g icing sugar until pale, then beat in 2 tbsp brandy a little at a time until fluffy. Chill 20 minutes. Wrap an 800g fruit cake in foil and warm at 160C for 15 minutes. Cut into thick slices and serve with the brandy butter and 150g vintage cheddar cut into wedges.

d.note: Hot milk cocoa with dark chocolate and condensed milk
d.how: Heat 900ml full cream milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Whisk in 3 tbsp cocoa, 80g chopped dark chocolate and 120ml condensed milk until smooth and frothy. Add a pinch of salt to bring out the chocolate. Pour into 4 enamel mugs and serve straight away while it is piping hot.

shopping: 40g butter, plus extra for the bread@Dairy
